title: Offensive line stats
intro: Pass protection and run blocking. Pressure rate allowed is pressures per dropback from Pro Football Reference. No-blitz pressure rate counts only dropbacks where the defense rushed four or fewer, so it isolates the line from blitz pickup; it comes from NFL Next Gen Stats tracking via nflverse; published for 2018–2025 so far, blank for this season until it is released. Time to throw, rush yards over expected (RYOE) and 8+ box rate are NFL Next Gen Stats weekly tracking, current season included. Yards before contact is per running-back carry.

columns.label: No-blitz pressure
columns.note: Pressured on dropbacks vs 4 or fewer rushers (NGS, 2018–2025)
